name: New Loka Knowledge Graph
domain: Healthcare Systems Engineering & Clinical Data Sovereignty

nodes.label: System Philosophy & Foundational Axioms
nodes.summary: Platform-agnostic core, local-first, CRDT sync, single core, adaptive engineering (ideological debt avoidance)

nodes.label: Deployment Tiers & Presets
nodes.summary: T0 (solo clinic) to T4 (federation), 22-role declarative presets, differential privacy mesh

nodes.label: FHIR R4 Clinical Models
nodes.summary: 23+ FHIR R4 resources including Consent, polymorphic FhirResource wrapper, soft delete, provenance

nodes.label: Storage, CRDT & Crypto
nodes.summary: SQLite engine via SQLx, AES-256-GCM AEAD at rest, DMK/PRK key hierarchy, vector clocks, delta sync

nodes.label: ABAC & Identity Management
nodes.summary: Core-enforced ABAC, Role::Billing clinical redaction, legal prescriber check, emergency break-glass

nodes.label: Audit Engine & Safety
nodes.summary: Tamper-evident append-only ledger, Ed25519 cryptographic signing, human review mandatory, HIPAA/DISHA/GDPR

nodes.label: CPOE & Diagnostics
nodes.summary: 5-stage order lifecycle, Routine/Urgent/Stat priorities, Radiology/Biochem/Path/Micro silos, panic labs

nodes.label: eRx Pad Pro & Formulary
nodes.summary: Native A4 prescription pad, 61k+ drug formulary, digital signature setup, offline sync

nodes.label: HTTP Server & API Surface
nodes.summary: Tokio/Axum 0.7 engine, rust-embed SPA, FHIR REST + Consent, departments/transfers, federation/research APIs

nodes.label: Web Clinical Interface
nodes.summary: Zero-dependency ES6 vanilla SPA, 35 clinical views (T3/T4 modules), Epic Storyboard rail, PRESET_REGISTRY

nodes.label: Command-Line Tooling
nodes.summary: newloka-cli with Clap v4, 12 command groups (departments, consent, research, federation), direct SQLite

nodes.label: Self-Updater & Releases
nodes.summary: In-app 1-click update, GitHub Releases polling, atomic rename-and-replace, air-gapped offline package upload

nodes.label: Public Web Presence
nodes.summary: newloka.org on Firebase Hosting (new-loka), Sage/Taupe brand system, live EMR v0.2.0 UI showcase, docs hub

nodes.label: Roadmap & Engineering Telemetry
nodes.summary: Current v0.2.0, 51 passing tests, 11-phase roadmap: Phases 1-3, 6, 9 Shipped, living requirements gap doc

nodes.label: Amethyst Sovereign Agent
nodes.summary: Sovereign systems engineer & architect, Clinical Invariant Doctrine, memory/skill self-evolution loop
